name: AgentStatus
label: Agent status
description: What an agent is doing right now, as a dot matrix and status line, a floating pill, a square mark for icon slots, or a ring around any element.

props.name: state
props.description: What the agent is doing. Drives the colour, the default label, and whether the matrix animates.

props.name: label
props.description: Status text. Falls back to a default for the state. Ignored when `children` are given.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Which dot-matrix choreography to run. Defaults to `breathe` while `waiting`, a still pulse that reads as the person's turn (the same as AgentStatusMark), and `orbit` otherwise.

props.name: shimmer
props.description:
Sweep a highlight across the label while the agent is active. Defaults to
on for `thinking`, `working` and `waiting`, off for the resting states.

props.name: size
props.description:
Indicator and text scale, paired with ChatMessage's sizes: `default`
matches default message text, `compact` matches compact message text.
`sm` and `md` are legacy aliases for `compact` and `default`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`inline` sits in a line of content; `bar` is a full-width row for the
top of a panel; `pill` is a glass pill for a status that floats over
the page while a run goes on; once it ends the dots fill solid in the
status colour, as in every variant. The pill does not position itself.

props.name: action
props.description: A trailing control after the status text, such as a link that opens the run. Meant for the `pill` and `bar` variants.

props.name: children
props.description: Status text, when it needs markup the `label` string cannot express.

props.name: state
props.description: What the agent is doing. Drives the colour and whether the dots animate, as on AgentStatus. Defaults to `working`, unlike AgentStatus's `thinking`: the mark stands in for an icon on a control (AiButton's, a pill's), where the commonest moment it is drawn is a run under way, while the labelled AgentStatus most often opens a reply.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Which choreography to run: every AgentStatus pattern, redrawn for the square grid. Defaults to `breathe` while `waiting`, a still pulse that reads as the person's turn, and `orbit` otherwise.
